title: New Song Spotlight
description: This week's spotlight is Rod Stewart's "Sailing" — a soaring, heartfelt anthem of longing and hope from his 1975 album Atlantic Crossing. An enduring signature hit and a UK #1, it rides a slow-burning swell of strings and emotion into a chorus people instinctively sing along to. In a Djembe set it lands as a warm, reflective lift — big feeling, wide-open space, and a room that sails with it.
songListNote: Song of the Week — Rod Stewart's timeless 1975 anthem "Sailing" joins the request catalog this week.
